ops.title: Stop repeated Git clone aborts in ref transaction finish
ops.description: Owner: /root/fresh_disk_gap_relief. Confirmed on2026-10-30: nine recent Git crash-report names in30minutes; eight parsed reports show SIGABRT with BUG_fl -> files_transaction_finish -> ref_transaction_commit -> cmd_clone. Git children run about1-2seconds under Claude parents; ReportCrash809 is stable sinceboot(runs1,neverexited), so do not restart the reporter or agents. Installed Git2.56.0 SHA25692229f2456a49561ac5d614bbed775224e2fc32a8eca22ac41aeb3ce47d7899c; Mach-O UUID matches all parsed reports. Evidence: FE/reportcrash-809-git-signatures.private.json and FE/git-clone-crash-binary-identity.json. Next executable step: bind exact BUG message/source line and live clone argv/CWD/caller, then isolate smallest CI-only positive/negative reproduction against pinned Git2.56.0 and existing upstream fix. Carry reviewed fix through CI/public release/forward installation and actual affected-case verification. No signals to agents/services; preserve valid ship/rebase/ledger work and cleanup pause. Pack-growth investigation remains queued behind this crash.

ops.text: Exact failing clone argv/CWD/caller and BUG message/source line bound to installed binary; minimal CI positive and negative controls identify the trigger.
Narrow reviewed upstream Git or existing caller fix passes required correctness/regression CI without hiding errors or changing unrelated ref semantics.
Verified official forward installation completes an actual affected clone with expected refs and no matching abort/report, preserving protected sessions and valid work; record bounded IO/CPU limits.
